config.length_policy: Local compressors retain fixed50% cap. Summary uses the original first complete generation, with requested50% target; report actual length and violations, with no edits or selection by length. Other five conditions and reader unchanged.

source_dataset.name: HotpotQA yes/no (distractor)
source_dataset.source_format: Hugging Face Parquet mirror; dev is named validation
source_dataset.selection_rule: answer.strip().lower() in {yes, no}; no balancing or outcome filtering
source_dataset.context_definition: All supplied titles and paragraphs (usually 10), original order; sentences joined by spaces. No supporting_facts.
source_dataset.scope: The supplied retrieved context is question-conditioned; only the compressor is query-blind.

source_dataset.name: QASPER yes/no (text evidence)
source_dataset.selection_rule: Nonempty body; all annotations boolean and consistent; every annotation has nonempty evidence found in the text; no figure/table evidence.
source_dataset.context_definition: Title, abstract and all sections/paragraphs in order. No questions, answers or evidence markers appended.
source_dataset.scope: Exploratory use of train; dev/test untouched. Evidence filtering changes label and task distribution. Each paper is compressed once and reused across its questions.

manifest.scope: Original first-draft summary; report budget violations. Other five conditions unchanged.
